definition_zh: 包；裹；缠绕；围住；（使）结束；（电影）拍完
definition_en: to cover something by folding paper or cloth around it, or to wind something around; also to finish an activity
core_image: 把东西放进去，四角折过来，一条细绳绕三圈系住
scene: 生日前夜，桌上摆着剪好的纸和一卷彩色带子，礼物还露着一角。 She wrapped the bowl in newspaper so it would survive the journey.
sceneCN: 这里 wrap 是「包、裹」（第 1 个义项：用纸或布把东西折起来盖住）；句意为她用报纸把碗包好，好让它经得住颠簸。四角折过来、细绳绕三圈，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 wrap 加 -er 构成，义为「包装纸；封套」
由 wrap 加 -ing 构成，义为「包装材料」
由 wrap 加 -ed 构成，义为「包好的；入神的」

senses.title: To cover it round
senses.definition: to fold paper or cloth right round a thing so that it is covered on all sides
senses.definitionCN: 把纸或布整个折起来围住某物，使其四面都被盖住
senses.example: She wrapped the bowl in newspaper so it would survive the journey.
senses.exampleCN: 她用报纸把碗包好，好让它经得住颠簸。
senses.why: The oldest sense is to wind cloth around something, and every other sense is that motion again.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是把布绕在东西上，其余义项都是这个动作的再现。

senses.title: To wind round and round
senses.definition: to put something such as a band or a cord round a thing several times
senses.definitionCN: 把带子、绳子之类在物体上绕好几圈
senses.example: A thin ribbon was wrapped twice around the box.
senses.exampleCN: 一条细带子在盒子上绕了两圈。
senses.why: The same motion is now used with a cord instead of a sheet, so the word still means to circle a thing.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动作换成绳而不是布，这个词仍然是把东西绕起来。

senses.title: To finish something
senses.definition: to bring an activity, a meeting or a filming to its end, as in wrap up
senses.definitionCN: 让一项活动、会议或拍摄告一段落，如 wrap up
senses.example: Let us wrap up the meeting before the train leaves.
senses.exampleCN: 咱们趁火车开走之前把会开完。
senses.why: When work is wrapped up, the last loose ends are folded in as if they were being covered, and then the whole is closed.
senses.whyCN: 把工作「包完」，就是把最后几处散头折进去，像盖住一样，然后把整体合上。

senses.title: To be absorbed in something
senses.definition: to give all one's attention to something, as in wrapped up in
senses.definitionCN: 把全部注意力放在某事上，如 wrapped up in
senses.example: He was so wrapped up in his book that he missed his stop.
senses.exampleCN: 他看得太入神，坐过了站。
senses.why: Attention wound tightly around one subject leaves nothing outside, so a person inside a book is wrapped in it.
senses.whyCN: 注意力紧紧绕在一个主题上，外面就什么都不剩，于是埋头读书的人便是被书「裹住」了。

intro.en: Wrap is of uncertain origin, appearing in Middle English as wrappen, and probably related to the older sense of turning and rolling.
intro.cn: wrap 的词源不确定，中古英语作 wrappen，可能与其更早的「翻转、滚卷」之意相关。

items.en: wrappen meant to wind or to fold a covering round something.
items.cn: wrappen 意为缠绕或用覆布把某物包起来。

items.en: No older Germanic form is certainly related, and its ancestry is still argued.
items.cn: 没有确定的更早日耳曼语形式与之相关，其渊源至今仍有争议。

items.en: The ending -er built wrapper for the paper and the cover.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 造出 wrapper，指包装纸与封套。

items.en: The sense to finish grew in American film making, where a shot was wrapped.
items.cn: 「结束」这一义项在美国电影制作中生长出来，镜头拍完就叫 wrapped。

items.en: The phrase under wraps, kept secret, comes from cloth keeping a thing hidden.
items.cn: under wraps（保密）来自用布把东西盖住藏起来。

note.en: The first group holds the derived forms, the second holds other verbs for covering and binding.
note.cn: 第一组收派生形式，第二组收其他表示包裹与捆扎的动词。

entries.definition: Covered, or wholly absorbed in something.
The paper or cover around a thing.
Material used for wrapping.
To put something over a thing.
To tie or fasten together.
To bend something over on itself.

normalIntro.en: Wrap ends in a single p, but doubles it before a vowel ending: wrapped, wrapping.
normalIntro.cn: wrap 末尾只有一个 p，但在元音词尾前要双写：wrapped、wrapping。

normal.en: Double the p before -ed and -ing: wrapped and wrapping, not wraped.
normal.cn: -ed 与 -ing 前双写 p：wrapped、wrapping，而不是 wraped。

normal.en: The past tense is wrapped, not wraped, because wrap is a one-syllable word ending in p.
normal.cn: 过去式是 wrapped，因为 wrap 是单音节且以 p 结尾。

normal.en: Wrap up means both to cover and to finish, so context decides.
normal.cn: wrap up 既指包起来也指结束，看上下文定。

normal.en: Under wraps means hidden from everyone, like a gift before the day.
normal.cn: under wraps 指藏起来不让知道，如节前的礼物。

normal.en: Rap is the look-alike with one p, meaning to knock; wrap with w covers.
normal.cn: 单写 p 的 rap 是敲击；带 w 的 wrap 是包裹。

abstract.en: Four corners folded in, then a string wound three times.
abstract.cn: 四角折进来，再绕三圈绳。

abstract.en: A gift still showing one corner of paper.
abstract.cn: 礼物还露着一角纸。

abstract.en: A person so inside a book that the world outside stops.
abstract.cn: 一个人陷在书里，外面的世界停了。

examples.en: Please wrap the glasses in paper before packing them.
examples.cn: 装之前请把杯子用纸包一下。

examples.en: We should wrap up the report before Friday.
examples.cn: 我们应该在周五之前把报告收尾。

examples.en: The present is still under wraps until his birthday.
examples.cn: 礼物到他生日之前一直保密。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「绕」——把东西一绕一包，就是 wrap。

root: 中古英语 wrappen（缠绕、包覆），更早来源不确定；加 -ed、-ing 时双写 p；-er 构成 wrapper。

sensesIntro.en: The cloth goes round the thing, then the cord winds round it, then the session is wound up, and finally attention is wound around one subject.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是布绕上东西，再是绳绕上东西，接着是把一场活动绕完，最后是把注意力绕在一件事上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: four corners folded in, a string wound three times.
core.cn: 核心意象：四角折入，绳绕三圈。

branches.en: The covering branch: a bowl wrapped in newspaper.
branches.cn: 包裹分支：用报纸包起的碗。

branches.en: The winding branch: ribbon wrapped twice around a box.
branches.cn: 缠绕分支：绕了两圈的带子。

branches.en: The ending branch: wrapping up a meeting before a train.
branches.cn: 结束分支：赶火车前把会开完。

branches.en: The absorption branch: too deep in a book to notice the stop.
branches.cn: 专注分支：看书入神坐过站。

branches.en: The privacy branch: kept under wraps, like a covered gift.
branches.cn: 隐秘分支：像盖住的礼物一样保密。

intro.en: Wrap is a short stem with a doubled p before endings, and -er and -ing build its nouns.
intro.cn: wrap 是短词干，词尾前双写 p，-er 与 -ing 构成其名词。

latinIntro.en: The stem has no Latin ancestor; the words below cover the same action from the Latin side.
latinIntro.cn: 词干没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词从拉丁语一侧表达同样的动作。

definition_zh: 贡献；捐款；来稿；促成作用
definition_en: something given to help a shared purpose, or the act of giving it
core_image: 一只罐子里叠着许多不同面额的硬币
scene: 会后名单贴在墙上，每个名字后面写着金额。 Her contribution made the project possible.
sceneCN: 这里 contribution 指「捐款」（第 2 个义项：为某项事业拿出的款项）；句意是她的捐款让这个项目得以启动。

pos.zh: 贡献；捐款；来稿；促成作用

senses.title: A share given
senses.definition: something valuable that a person gives to a shared effort
senses.definitionCN: 个人为共同事业拿出的有价值之物
senses.example: Her contribution to the team was never forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 她对团队的贡献从未被忘记。
senses.why: A group remembers what one pair of hands added.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体会记住某一双手添了什么。

senses.title: Money given
senses.definition: a sum of money given to a cause or a group
senses.definitionCN: 为某项事业或团体拿出的款项
senses.example: The school asked for a small contribution.
senses.exampleCN: 学校请求大家小额捐款。
senses.why: Coins in a box become a building in time.
senses.whyCN: 盒子里的硬币，久了会变成一座楼。

senses.title: A piece written
senses.definition: a text sent to a paper, magazine or collection
senses.definitionCN: 寄给报刊或文集的文章
senses.example: The magazine printed four contributions.
senses.exampleCN: 杂志刊出了四篇来稿。
senses.why: A page is a meeting place, not a single voice.
senses.whyCN: 一个版面是聚会的场所，不只是一个人的声音。

intro.en: Contribution comes from Latin contributio, a bringing together of shares, from contribuere, built on com-, together, and tribuere, to allot.
intro.cn: contribution 来自拉丁语 contributio（各份的汇集），源于 contribuere，由 com-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

items.en: Tribuere meant to assign a part to each person.
items.cn: tribuere 意为给每人分配一份。

items.en: Contribuere meant to bring those parts into one place.
items.cn: contribuere 意为把各份带到一个地方。

items.en: Contributio named the common fund so formed.
items.cn: contributio 指这样形成的公库。

items.en: French contribution kept the sense of a paid share.
items.cn: 法语 contribution 保留了缴付一份的意思。

items.en: English contribution widened to effort and writing.
items.cn: 英语 contribution 扩大到力气与文字。

items.en: It now also names a single act of helping.
items.cn: 如今它也指一次具体的帮忙。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin allotting base tribut-, and the meaning group names other words for what is given to a shared end.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的分配词基 tribut-，近义组列出其他表示为共同目标给出的东西。

entries.definition: to give a share to a common purpose
a person who gives or writes for others
the handing out of things to many people
money or goods given to a cause
something put in to help a process
a part that belongs to one person

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with value added by one pair of hands, then move to coins in a box and an article sent to a page.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一双添上的手开始，再到盒子里的硬币，最后到寄给版面的文章。

normal.en: Contribution is the noun behind contribute: the thing you put in.
normal.cn: contribution 是 contribute 背后的名词：你放进去的那样东西。

normal.en: A team remembers the one who carried the water.
normal.cn: 一个团队会记住那个挑水的人。

normal.en: Small coins in a box become walls in time.
normal.cn: 盒子里的零钱，日子久了会变成墙。

normal.en: An article is also a dish on a shared table.
normal.cn: 一篇文章也是公共餐桌上的一道菜。

normal.en: Give a part, and the whole is different.
normal.cn: 给出一份，整体就不一样了。

abstract.en: Picture one coin resting on a tall pile.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚硬币落在高高的一堆上。

abstract.en: Picture a name written under a given sum.
abstract.cn: 想象一个名字写在一笔金额之下。

abstract.en: Picture many pens filling one printed page.
abstract.cn: 想象许多支笔写满同一个版面。

examples.en: He made a real contribution to the research.
examples.cn: 他对这项研究作出了真正的贡献。

examples.en: A small contribution from each member was enough.
examples.cn: 每位成员捐一点就够了。

examples.en: The paper welcomes contributions from readers.
examples.cn: 这份报纸欢迎读者来稿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contribution 记成 contribute（贡献）加 ion（名词尾）：大家各出一份凑起来的那个东西，就是贡献。

root: 源自拉丁语 contributio（各份的汇集），来自 contribuere（把份额凑到一起），由 con-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

sensesIntro.en: From a valuable share, to a sum of money, and at last to a piece of writing sent to a page.
sensesIntro.cn: 从有价值的一份，到一笔钱，最后到寄给版面的文字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one coin laid on a tall stack of coins.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚硬币放在高高的一摞硬币上。

branches.en: The widest sense covers any valuable share.
branches.cn: 最宽的义项涵盖任何有价值的一份。

branches.en: Money is the shape this share most often takes.
branches.cn: 钱是这一份最常见的形状。

branches.en: A written piece is a share of words.
branches.cn: 一篇文字是文字上的一份。

branches.en: Effort and money both fill the same pool.
branches.cn: 力气和钱都往同一个池子里倒。

branches.en: A gift and a column both reach other people.
branches.cn: 捐款与专栏最后都到了别人手里。

intro.en: Contribution is built on contribute plus the noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: contribution 由 contribute 加名词词尾 -ion 构成。

latinIntro.en: The allotting base tribut- also appears in tribute, distribute and attribute.
latinIntro.cn: 分配词基 tribut- 也出现在 tribute、distribute 与 attribute 中。

items.meaning: the share that has been given
items.exampleCN: 这笔捐助被记录了下来。

items.example: The delay was a contributory cause.
They paid tribute to the old teacher.

items.meaning: to give a cause to something
items.example: He attributes the win to practice.

definition_zh: 有效地；实际上；几乎
definition_en: in a way that produces the intended result, in practice though not officially, or almost
core_image: 开关一按，机器立刻转起来——事情真的被推动了
scene: 雨越下越大，露天演出还没开始就被叫停了。 The open-air show was effectively cancelled before it began.
sceneCN: 这里 effectively 是「实际上、等于」（第 2 个义项：虽未正式宣布，实际结果已经如此）；句意是露天演出还没开始就等于被取消了。

pos.zh: 副词：有效地；实际上；几乎

forms.label: 比较级（副词，多音节用 more）
最高级（副词，多音节用 most）

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉副词后缀 -ly 得到，义为「有效的；生效的」
由 effective 加 -ness 构成，义为「有效性」
由 effective 加否定前缀 in- 构成，义为「无效的」

senses.title: In a way that succeeds
senses.definition: in a manner that produces the result intended
senses.definitionCN: 以能产生预期结果的方式
senses.example: The team communicated effectively during the crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 危机期间团队沟通得很有效。
senses.why: -ly turns effective into a manner: the result aimed at is actually reached.
senses.whyCN: -ly 把 effective 变成方式状语：瞄准的结果真的被达到了。

senses.title: In practice, though not officially
senses.definition: in effect or virtually, when the real situation is considered
senses.definitionCN: 从真实情况看已经如此，虽然并未正式宣布
senses.example: The old system was effectively dead by then.
senses.exampleCN: 到那时旧制度实际上已经死了。
senses.why: What is true in practice acts like a fact, so the adverb can mean virtually.
senses.whyCN: 在实践中成立的事就像事实一样起作用，所以这个副词可以表示「实际上、几乎」。

senses.title: Almost; practically
senses.definition: used before amounts or states to mean almost or for all practical purposes
senses.definitionCN: 用在数量或状态前，表示「几乎」或「就实际而言」
senses.example: The extra cost was effectively zero.
senses.exampleCN: 额外成本实际上几乎为零。
senses.why: If a quantity carries no practical weight, the adverb says it is almost nothing.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个数量在实践中没有分量，这个副词就说它几乎等于没有。

intro.en: Effectively is English effective plus -ly; the stem itself goes back through French to Latin effectivus.
intro.cn: effectively 是英语 effective 加 -ly；词干本身经法语上溯到拉丁语 effectivus。

items.en: Effectus, a thing done, is the noun at the base of the family.
items.cn: effectus（做成之事）是整个词族底层的名词。

items.en: The adjective named the power to produce a result.
items.cn: 这个形容词指产生结果的力量。

items.en: French shortened the ending to -if and added the sense of being real.
items.cn: 法语把词尾简化为 -if，并加入「实际的」这一层意思。

items.en: English formed the adjective and used it for medicines, measures and laws.
items.cn: 英语构成这个形容词，用于药物、措施与法律。

items.en: The adverb -ly spread from manner into the looser sense of in practice.
items.cn: 副词 -ly 从「方式」扩展到更宽松的「实际上」。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the effect family; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs of practical reality.
note.cn: 形近组收 effect 词族；近义组收表示「实际上」的副词。

entries.definition: Able to produce the wanted result, or officially in force.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有效的、生效的」，是本词的词基。

entries.definition: The quality of being effective.
A noun for a result or a verb meaning to bring something about.
entries.definitionCN: 名词指结果，动词指使某事发生。

entries.definition: In effect or almost, without being formally true.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「实际上、几乎」，但并非正式成立。

entries.definition: Almost, or in practical terms rather than in theory.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「几乎」或「就实际而言」。

entries.definition: In essence, when the main point is considered.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「本质上、基本上」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a switch that works and then loosen into the everyday claim that something is as good as done.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从一个真的管用的开关出发，再松到日常说法里「等于已经如此」。

normal.en: Effectively is effective plus -ly: the manner in which the result is reached.
normal.cn: effectively 是 effective 加 -ly：结果被达到的那种方式。

normal.en: A team that communicates effectively gets the message across the first time.
normal.cn: 有效沟通的团队一次就把话说到了。

normal.en: A cancelled show can be effectively cancelled before any sign is posted.
normal.cn: 一场演出可以在贴出告示之前就等于被取消了。

normal.en: Effectively zero means the cost is there on paper but weighs nothing.
normal.cn: effectively zero 指账面上有成本，实际却没有分量。

normal.en: The adverb moves from how you work to what is true in practice.
normal.cn: 这个副词从「你怎么做」滑到「实践上是什么样」。

abstract.en: Picture a switch pressed and a machine starting at once.
abstract.cn: 想象开关一按，机器立刻转起来。

abstract.en: The same press can be a good meeting, a dead system, or a cost near zero.
abstract.cn: 同一次按下可以是开好一场会、一个死掉的制度，或一笔近乎为零的成本。

abstract.en: Effectively means the result is already there, whether or not anyone announces it.
abstract.cn: effectively 意味着结果已经在那里，无论有没有人宣布。

examples.en: The team communicated effectively during the crisis.
examples.cn: 危机期间团队沟通得很有效。

examples.en: The old system was effectively dead by then.
examples.cn: 到那时旧制度实际上已经死了。

examples.en: The extra cost was effectively zero.
examples.cn: 额外成本实际上几乎为零。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「伊费克提夫利」——雨一大，露天演出等于没演

root: 由 effective 加副词后缀 -ly 构成；effective 出自拉丁语 effectivus「能产生结果的」，再往前是 efficere「做出、完成」。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses of effectively: in a way that succeeds, in practice though not officially, and almost.
sensesIntro.cn: effectively 的三个义项：以有效的方式、实际上（虽未正式）、几乎。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a switch pressed, and the machine starts at once.
core.cn: 核心意象：开关一按，机器立刻转起来。

chain: THE PLAIN WAY TO SAY IT

branches.en: THE MANNER: the work is done in a way that reaches the result.
branches.cn: 方式线：做事的方式真的达到了结果。

branches.en: THE PRACTICE: the situation is already so, without a formal word.
branches.cn: 实际线：没有正式说法，情况已经如此。

branches.en: THE AMOUNT: a quantity is there but weighs almost nothing.
branches.cn: 数量线：数量还在，却几乎没有分量。

branches.en: THE SLIDE: the same adverb slides from doing well to being almost nothing.
branches.cn: 滑动线：同一个副词从「做得好」滑到「几乎为零」。

branches.en: THE VERDICT: both loosen the statement to what is true in practice.
branches.cn: 判断线：两者都把话放松到「实践上成立」。

intro.en: Effectively is a transparent English build: the effect stem, an adjective ending, and the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: effectively 是透明的英语构词：effect 词干、形容词词尾，再加副词词尾 -ly。

latinIntro.en: The Latin noun and adjective are recorded; English -ly is a native suffix, so nothing here needs reconstruction except the oldest root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语名词与形容词都有记录；英语 -ly 是本土词尾，因此除最古老词根外无需重构。

items.example: It lies at the base of the family.
It is the bare stem of the family.

definition_zh: 尽管；虽然；不顾
definition_en: used to say that something happens even though another thing could have stopped it
core_image: 雨水顺着伞骨往下淌，伞下的人仍旧往前走
scene: 风把海报吹得翻卷起来，来听讲座的人还是坐满了屋子。 Despite the heavy rain, the whole class came on time.
sceneCN: 这里 despite 指「尽管」（第 1 个义项：表示某事没有被另一情况阻止）；句意是尽管下着大雨，全班还是准时到了。

senses.title: It happened anyway
senses.definition: used before a noun to show that something did not prevent an action
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，表示某情况并未阻止某个动作
senses.example: Despite the heavy rain, the whole class came on time.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管下着大雨，全班还是准时到了。
senses.why: One force pushes, and the thing still moves the other way.
senses.whyCN: 一股力量推过来，那件事却仍旧朝另一边走。

senses.title: Against someone's wishes
senses.definition: used before a noun to show that an action goes against what someone wants or feels
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，表示某行为违背某人的意愿或情感
senses.example: Despite his family's wishes, he left the farm for the city.
senses.exampleCN: 不顾家人的意愿，他离开农场去了城市。
senses.why: The word once meant looking down on someone, and a trace of that refusal remains.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从前指俯视某人，那种不理会至今还留着一丝痕迹。

intro.en: Despite came from Old French despit, contempt, from Latin despectus, a looking down on, built on de- and specere, to look.
intro.cn: despite 来自古法语 despit（轻蔑），源于拉丁语 despectus（俯视），由 de- 与 specere（看）构成。

items.en: Specere meant to look, and despicere meant to look down on.
items.cn: specere 指看，despicere 指往下看、瞧不起。

items.en: Despectus named the contempt itself.
items.cn: despectus 指的就是这种轻蔑本身。

items.en: Despit carried both scorn and the phrase in despite of.
items.cn: despit 既带着蔑视，也带着 in despite of 这个说法。

items.en: English shortened the phrase until despite stood alone as a preposition.
items.cn: 英语把这个短语越缩越短，最后 despite 独自成了介词。

items.en: The scorn faded, leaving only the sense of something not stopping you.
items.cn: 轻蔑的色彩淡去，只留下「某事拦不住你」这一层。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the spit or spect shape, and the meaning group all mark a contrast that did not change the result.
note.cn: 形近组共用 spit 或 spect 的形状，近义组则都标记一种没能改变结果的对照。

entries.definition: a wish to hurt someone
full of a wish to hurt
to feel strong contempt for someone
in spite of a fact
even though something is true
without being affected by something

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with rain running off an umbrella and end with a family waving goodbye at a gate.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从雨水顺着伞骨往下淌开始，落到门口挥手告别的家人。

normal.en: Despite sets up a wall and then walks straight through it.
normal.cn: despite 先砌一堵墙，然后径直穿过去。

normal.en: The word once meant looking down, so it still refuses to bow.
normal.cn: 这个词从前指往下看，所以至今也不肯低头。

normal.en: Despite takes a noun; although takes a whole sentence.
normal.cn: despite 后面接名词，although 后面接一整句。

normal.en: Rain, warnings, wishes: all can follow despite and change nothing.
normal.cn: 雨、警告、家人的意愿，都能跟在 despite 后面，却什么也改变不了。

normal.en: Despite everything is what people say when they are still standing.
normal.cn: 还站着的人，才会说 despite everything。

abstract.en: Picture an umbrella bent forward against a strong wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一把伞顶着大风向前倾。

abstract.en: Picture wet footprints leading into a dry hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一串湿脚印一直通向干燥的大厅。

abstract.en: Picture a packed room while the storm hits the windows.
abstract.cn: 想象窗外风雨拍打，屋里却坐满了人。

examples.en: Despite the heavy rain, the whole class came on time.
examples.cn: 尽管下着大雨，全班还是准时到了。

examples.en: Despite his family's wishes, he left the farm for the city.
examples.cn: 不顾家人的意愿，他离开农场去了城市。

examples.en: The plan failed despite all their efforts.
examples.cn: 尽管他们尽了全力，计划还是失败了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 despite 记成「地死拜特」：de 是去掉，spite 是阻碍，阻碍被去掉，事情照做，就是尽管。

root: 来自古法语 despit（轻蔑），源于拉丁语 despectus（俯视），由 de-（向下）与 specere（看）构成。本义是瞧不起、不放在眼里，短语 in despite of 逐渐缩成介词，表示某情况存在却没能阻止某事，也指不顾某人的意愿。

sensesIntro.en: From a look of contempt, to a preposition that lets an obstacle stand and then walks past it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从轻蔑的一瞥，到一个先让障碍站着、再从旁边走过去的介词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an obstacle standing still while the action passes it.
core.cn: 核心意象：障碍站着不动，行动却从旁边过去了。

branches.en: The first sense is an obstacle that fails to stop anything.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是一个没能拦住任何事的障碍。

branches.en: The second sense is a person's wish treated the same way.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是某人的意愿被同样对待。

branches.en: Rain, cost and distance are the usual things it stands before.
branches.cn: 雨、代价与距离，是它最常挡在前面的东西。

branches.en: A storm and a family's advice both count as things not listened to.
branches.cn: 一场暴雨与家人的劝告，都算作没被听从的东西。

branches.en: The old contempt survives only as this quiet refusal to yield.
branches.cn: 古老的轻蔑只剩下这一点安静的、不肯让步。

intro.en: Despite is tied to a family of looking down and of spite, which still colours the modern preposition.
intro.cn: despite 与一族表示俯视和怨恨的词相连，这层色彩至今还在影响这个介词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin specere, to look; de- points the look downward, and despicere means to scorn.
latinIntro.cn: 它的词基是拉丁语 specere（看），de- 把目光转向下方，despicere 就是轻视。

items.example: They went out despite the cold.
items.exampleCN: 尽管很冷，他们还是出门了。

items.example: He said it out of spite.

items.meaning: full of a wish to hurt

items.example: The old rule was widely despised.

items.exampleCN: 他离开时没有鄙视任何人。

definition_zh: 预告片；拖车；挂车；活动房屋
definition_en: a short film preview, or a vehicle pulled behind another vehicle
core_image: 被大车拖着跑的小车厢：一段被拖在正片前面的短片
scene: 公路服务区外，一辆挂车缓缓停稳，司机下车查看货物：电影开场前，银幕上突然响起轰鸣声，一段精彩的短片让全场安静下来看完了 trailer。
sceneCN: 这里 trailer 是「预告片」（第 1 个义项：电影前导短片）；句意是正片前的预告片吸引全场。

pos.zh: 预告片；拖车；挂车；活动房屋

derivatives.zh: 口语俚语：住在活动房屋里的人，由 trailer 加 -ite 构成（非正式用法）
与 trailer 相关的动作词「拖、牵引」，非派生但常用搭配词

senses.title: A short preview shown before a film
senses.definition: a short film of scenes from an upcoming movie, shown to advertise it
senses.definitionCN: 为宣传新片而剪辑的即将上映电影的短片
senses.example: The trailer for the new space film made everyone cheer.
senses.exampleCN: 这部新太空电影的预告片让全场欢呼。
senses.why: The trailer is dragged out in front of the main film, just like the cart in front.
senses.whyCN: 预告片被「拖」到正片前放映，正如拖车跟在车后——被拖者先露面。

senses.title: A vehicle pulled behind a car or lorry
senses.definition: a wheeled vehicle drawn by another vehicle, used to carry loads or people
senses.definitionCN: 由其他车辆牵引的带轮车辆，用于载货或载人
senses.example: They packed the boat onto the trailer behind the car.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把小艇装上车后的拖车。
senses.why: The core image is something carried by being pulled along.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是被拖着走、驮在身后的东西。

senses.title: A mobile home in a park or site
senses.definition: a caravan or mobile home that can be towed and lived in
senses.definitionCN: 可牵引居住的房车或移动住宅
senses.example: The family spent the summer in a trailer by the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人夏天住在湖边的活动房屋里。
senses.why: A home on wheels is still a thing pulled behind a car.
senses.whyCN: 装上轮子的家，本质上仍是车后拖着的东西。

intro.en: Trailer is the agent noun of trail, to pull behind, from Old French trailler, to follow or track, of Germanic origin. It first named a thing drawn behind, then the film dragged out before the main show.
intro.cn: trailer 是动词 trail 的施动名词，trail 来自古法语 trailler（跟随、追踪），一般认为源自日耳曼语。最初指被拖拽之物，后指被「拖」到正片之前的短片。

items.en: A Germanic root for dragging gave Old French trailler, to follow or tow.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语「拖曳」词根经古法语 trailler 表示「跟随、牵引」。

items.en: The verb trail meant to drag behind or follow a track.
items.cn: 中古英语动词 trail 意为「拖在后面；循迹而行」。

items.en: Trailer named whatever was towed: a cart, a boat cradle, a net.
items.cn: trailer 指一切被拖之物：拖车、船架、渔网。

items.en: Film studios used the word for the preview dragged out before the feature.
items.cn: 20 世纪电影界用该词指被拖放到正片前的预告短片。

items.en: Added the American sense of a towable mobile home.
items.cn: 又增加美式「拖车式活动房屋」的含义。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to trailer, and words in the film-preview field.
note.cn: 与 trailer 形近音近的词，以及同属影片宣传义场的词。

entries.definition: a path or to follow behind
entries.definitionCN: 小径；追踪，trailer 的动词根

entries.definition: a person who makes clothes
entries.definitionCN: 裁缝，与 trailer 发音几乎相同但词源不同

entries.definition: a bar or railway line
entries.definitionCN: 栏杆；铁轨，藏在 trailer 的拼写里但词源无关

entries.definition: a very short early preview
entries.definitionCN: 先导预告；悬念短片，预告片的一种

entries.definition: a lorry with a detachable trailer
entries.definitionCN: 拖挂卡车，trailer 的典型应用

entries.definition: a towable living vehicle
entries.definitionCN: （英）房车；大篷车，与美式 trailer 同义

entries.definition: an advance showing
entries.definitionCN: 预映；预览，更笼统的说法

normalIntro.en: Remember that the preview is dragged out before the film.
normalIntro.cn: 记住预告片是被「拖」到正片前面的。

normal.en: trailer = trail + er: the thing that trails behind
normal.cn: trailer＝trail（拖）+ er：跟在后面的东西

normal.en: film trailer plays before the film
normal.cn: 电影预告片在正片之前播放——被拖者先露面

normal.en: trailer park: homes on wheels
normal.cn: trailer park＝活动房屋社区，轮子上的家

normal.en: tailor vs trailer: the tailor sews, the trailer trails
normal.cn: tailor（裁缝）缝衣，trailer 拖拽，发音相近勿混

normal.en: teaser trailer comes even earlier
normal.cn: teaser trailer（先导预告）比正式预告更早发布

abstract.en: A little wagon rolling behind the big truck down the highway
abstract.cn: 公路上小拖车跟在大卡车后面滚动

abstract.en: A burst of exciting scenes flashing before the main film begins
abstract.cn: 正片开始前闪过一串精彩片段

abstract.en: A house riding quietly on four wheels beside the lake
abstract.cn: 一座房子安安静静踩着四个轮子停在湖边

examples.en: We watched the trailer and decided to book two tickets.
examples.cn: 我们看了预告片，决定订两张票。

examples.en: The lorry pulled a long trailer full of furniture.
examples.cn: 卡车拖着一节装满家具的长挂车。

examples.en: They live in a trailer near the coast all winter.
examples.cn: 他们整个冬天住在海边的一辆活动房屋里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹了儿」——预告片把最精彩的部分全「吹」了出来：先吹后看。拖车跟在车后，预告片排在片前，都叫 trailer。

root: trail（拖、循迹）的施动名词 + -er：被拖之物。trail 一般认为经古法语 trailler 源自日耳曼语「拖曳」词根。

sensesIntro.en: From the cart towed behind, the word leapt to the film dragged before the show and the home on wheels.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被拖的车厢跳到被「拖」到片头的短片，再变成轮子上的家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something carried by being pulled along
core.cn: 核心意象：被拖着走、驮在身后的东西

branches.en: the preview dragged before the feature
branches.cn: 被拖到正片前的预告

branches.en: the wheeled vehicle towed by a car or lorry
branches.cn: 被汽车或卡车牵引的挂车

branches.en: a home that can be towed away
branches.cn: 可以被拖走的家

branches.en: both appear because something stronger pulls them
branches.cn: 两者都因更强者的牵引而存在

branches.en: from two minutes of film to a whole life on wheels
branches.cn: 从两分钟短片到整轮子上的生活

intro.en: Trailer keeps the native -er agent suffix on the verb trail.
intro.cn: trailer 在动词 trail 上保留本土施动后缀 -er。

latinIntro.en: Trailer has no Latin relatives; it descends from a Germanic root through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: trailer 没有拉丁同族词，一般认为经古法语源自日耳曼语根。

items.meaning: to drag behind or follow a track
to pull by rope or chain
the people trailing behind a VIP

definition_zh: 条约；协议；协定
definition_en: a formal written agreement between two or more countries, signed by their governments
core_image: 长桌两端两位代表同时落笔，纸页上并排着两种文字的签名
scene: 大厅里两张长桌拼在一起，两国的代表各自翻开文件夹。 The two countries signed a peace treaty after a year of talks.
sceneCN: 这里 treaty 是「条约」（第 1 个义项：两国或多国政府签署的正式书面协议）；句意为经过一年谈判，两国签署了和平条约。长桌上并排的两份签名，就是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: treaty 的词源动词，义为「对待；谈判」
由 treat 加 -ment 构成，义为「对待；处理」
与 treaty 同源的词，义为「论文；专著」

senses.title: The signed paper
senses.definition: a formal agreement between states, written down and signed by those in power
senses.definitionCN: 国家之间写下并由掌权者签署的正式协议
senses.example: The two countries signed a peace treaty after a year of talks.
senses.exampleCN: 经过一年谈判，两国签署了和平条约。
senses.why: Medieval Latin tractatus meant a handling or a discussion, and a treaty is the paper produced when talks end.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 tractatus 意为处理或讨论，treaty 就是讨论结束后产生的那份文书。

senses.title: A deal between groups
senses.definition: an agreement of the same kind made by other large bodies such as companies
senses.definitionCN: 公司等大型机构之间订立的同类协议
senses.example: The two firms signed a treaty on sharing the harbour.
senses.exampleCN: 两家公司就共用港口签署了一份协议。
senses.why: The word began to travel from governments to any body large enough to act like one.
senses.whyCN: 这个词开始从政府延伸到任何大到能像政府一样行动的机构。

intro.en: Treaty comes from the Latin verb tractare, to handle or discuss, through the noun tractatus, a discussion.
intro.cn: treaty 经由名词 tractatus（讨论）来自拉丁语动词 tractare（处理、商谈）。

items.en: Tractare meant to drag, handle, and later to discuss or negotiate.
items.cn: tractare 意为拖动、处理，后来指讨论与商谈。

items.en: Tractatus named a treatment or a written discussion of a subject.
items.cn: tractatus 指一次处理，或对某主题的书面论述。

items.en: French made traitie, a discussion that ends in an agreement.
items.cn: 法语造出 traitie，指以协议告终的商讨。

items.en: English treaty first meant any negotiation between rulers.
items.cn: 中古英语的 treaty 最初指统治者之间的任何谈判。

items.en: By the modern period the word meant the signed document itself.
items.cn: 到了近代，这个词指已签署的文件本身。

note.en: The first group shares the tract stem, the second holds other words for formal agreements.
note.cn: 第一组共享 tract 词干，第二组收其他表示正式协定的词。

entries.definition: To behave toward someone or to give medical care.
The way a person or thing is handled.
A long written work on a subject.
An arrangement accepted by both sides.
A firm promise between parties.
A formal settlement between states.

normalIntro.en: Treaty hides the same root as treat: talks that end in a treaty are talks that have been handled to a finish.
normalIntro.cn: treaty 藏着与 treat 相同的词根：以条约结束的谈判，就是把事情处理到底的商谈。

normal.en: The plural changes y to ies: treaties.
normal.cn: 复数把 y 变 ies：treaties。

normal.en: The word begins with treat, the everyday verb.
normal.cn: 这个词以日常动词 treat 开头。

normal.en: A peace treaty is the most common phrase of all.
normal.cn: peace treaty 是最常见的搭配。

normal.en: The stress is on the first syllable: TREAty.
normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：TREAty。

normal.en: A treaty is signed, broken, or kept, like a promise on paper.
normal.cn: 条约和纸上的承诺一样，会被签署、违反或遵守。

abstract.en: Two pens meeting on the same line.
abstract.cn: 两支笔落在同一条线上。

abstract.en: A page with two languages and two seals.
abstract.cn: 一张写着两种语言、盖着两枚印章的纸。

abstract.en: The silence after the last signature.
abstract.cn: 最后一个签名之后的那份安静。

examples.en: Both sides hope to reach a treaty before the winter.
examples.cn: 双方希望在入冬前达成一项条约。

examples.en: The old treaty fixed the border along the river.
examples.cn: 旧条约以河流划定边界。

examples.en: They met to discuss a trade agreement between the neighbours.
examples.cn: 他们开会讨论邻国之间的贸易协定。

dict_mnemonic.text: treat（商谈处理）＋ y——商谈到底后签下的那张纸，就是条约。

root: 经由古法语 traitie 来自拉丁语 tractatus（处理、讨论），词根 tract- 意为「拉、处理」；同源词有 treat、treatment、treatise。

sensesIntro.en: First the signed document between states, then the same kind of deal between large bodies.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是国家之间签署的文件，再是大型机构之间的同类协议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two pens landing on the same line.
core.cn: 核心意象：两支笔落在同一行上。

branches.en: The state branch: an agreement between governments.
branches.cn: 国家分支：政府之间的协议。

branches.en: The body branch: a deal between large groups.
branches.cn: 机构分支：大集团之间的协议。

branches.en: The paper branch: both end in a signed document.
branches.cn: 文书分支：两者都以签署的文件告终。

branches.en: The border branch: treaties draw lines on maps.
branches.cn: 边界分支：条约在地图上画线。

branches.en: The talk branch: all of it begins as discussion.
branches.cn: 商谈分支：一切从讨论开始。

intro.en: Treaty is built on the Latin stem tract, drawn or handled, with an Old French noun ending on top.
intro.cn: treaty 建在拉丁词干 tract（拉、处理）之上，外面套着古法语的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin trahere, to pull, gives the family of tract, treat, and treaty, listed below.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trahere（拉）生出 tract、treat 与 treaty 这一词族，列在下面。

items.example: The root links pulling and dealing with people.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把「拉」与「应对人」连在一起。

items.example: It turns the handling into a document.
items.exampleCN: 它把处理的过程变成一份文件。

items.meaning: to behave toward, to deal with
items.example: The verb keeps the plain sense of handling.
items.exampleCN: 动词保留处理的朴素含义。

items.example: The noun names the finished paper.
Ment marks the manner of handling.
A treatise handles a subject on paper.

senses.title: A short piece of writing
senses.definition: a short piece of writing that gives the writer's ideas on a subject

senses.example: She wrote an essay on modern art.

definition_zh: 分别地；各自地；按顺序地
definition_en: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned
core_image: 两组名字并排排列，箭头一一对应

senses.title: In matching order
senses.definition: used to show that two lists match item by item in the order given
senses.definitionCN: 用于表明两个列表按给出的顺序逐项对应
senses.example: Tom and Anna scored ninety and eighty respectively.
senses.exampleCN: 汤姆和安娜分别得了九十分和八十分。
senses.why: The adverb of respective marks that each number looks back to its own person in order.
senses.whyCN: respective 的副词形式标示每个数字都按顺序回指各自的人。

senses.title: Separately, each in its own way
senses.definition: separately, with each item having its own place or role
senses.definitionCN: 分开地，每项都有自己的位置或角色

senses.exampleCN: 两株植物分别在阴处和阳光下接受测试。
senses.why: The pairing idea can also stress that the items are handled separately.
senses.whyCN: 配对概念也可以强调各项被分开处理。

intro.en: Respectively is respective plus -ly, from Latin respicere, to look back, so it marks a look back to each item in order.

senses.title: Mention something briefly
senses.definition: to mention or speak about someone or something, often briefly or indirectly
senses.definitionCN: 提及或谈到某人某事，常为简短或间接地谈到
senses.example: In her speech she referred to her difficult early years.
senses.exampleCN: 她在演讲中提到了自己艰难的早年岁月。
senses.why: To refer is to point back at something: the finger goes out and the listener follows it to the thing pointed at.
senses.whyCN: refer 的本义是「指回去」：手指伸出去，听者顺着它走到所指之物那里。

senses.title: Name someone or something as
senses.definition: to use a particular name or description for someone or something, as in refer to someone as something
senses.definitionCN: 用某个名称或说法称呼某人某物，如 refer to someone as… 结构
senses.example: Locals still refer to him as the mayor though he retired years ago.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管他多年前已退休，当地人仍称他为市长。
senses.why: Pointing becomes naming: the pointing finger fixes on a person and attaches a label to what it touches.
senses.whyCN: 指点变成命名：指向的手指停在一个人身上，并给被指之物贴上标签。

senses.title: Send someone to a source of information
senses.definition: to direct someone to a book, document, or person where they can find information
senses.definitionCN: 让某人去某本书、某份文件或某个人那里查找信息
senses.example: The librarian referred the student to the archives on the third floor.
senses.exampleCN: 图书管理员指引那位学生去三楼的档案室查阅。
senses.why: When you cannot answer yourself, you carry the question back to its proper source — the sense keeps the Latin idea of carrying something back to its origin.
senses.whyCN: 当你自己答不上来，就把问题带回它本来的源头——这个义项保留了拉丁语「带回原处」的观念。

senses.title: Consult a source while working
senses.definition: to look at a book, list, or note in order to get information, often while doing something else
senses.definitionCN: 为获取信息而查看书、名单或笔记，常与手头的事同时进行
senses.example: During the exam we could refer to the formula sheet.
senses.exampleCN: 考试时我们可以翻看公式表。
senses.why: Here the person does the going themselves: instead of being sent to the source, the speaker travels back to it whenever needed.
senses.whyCN: 这里是自己动手：不再被派去源头，而是需要时自己随时回到源头那里。

senses.title: Pass a person or case to someone else
senses.definition: to send a person to a specialist, or a case to a court or committee, because someone else can deal with it better
senses.definitionCN: 因为他人更擅长处理，而把病人转给专科医生、把案件转给法院或委员会
senses.example: Her doctor referred her to a heart specialist.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把她转诊给心脏专科医生。
senses.why: The thing referred is physically carried back and handed over to the proper handler, whether a patient or a legal file.
senses.whyCN: 被 refer 的对象被实实在在地带回去、移交到合适的人手里——不论是一位病人还是一份案卷。

senses.title: Attribute something to a source
senses.definition: to say that something belongs to or comes from a particular cause, time, or group
senses.definitionCN: 说明某事物属于或来自某个原因、时期或类别
senses.example: The committee referred the decline in numbers to the new visa rules.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会把人数下降归因于新的签证规定。
senses.why: Carrying a fact back to its origin is exactly what attribution is: the effect is connected back to its cause.
senses.whyCN: 把一个事实带回到它的源头，正是「归因」：结果被重新连接到它的原因上。

senses.title: Have something as the subject
senses.definition: of a word, sign, or symbol, to point to the person or thing it stands for
senses.definitionCN: 指词语、符号或标志所指向的、它所代表的人或事物
senses.example: The pronoun she refers to the queen in the previous sentence.
senses.exampleCN: 代词 she 指前一句中的王后。
senses.why: Language itself points: every word is a finger that reaches out to what it means, so the word refers.
senses.whyCN: 语言本身就在指认：每个词都是一根伸向所指之物的手指，所以说这个词 refers。

senses.title: Be about a particular matter
senses.definition: of a remark or document, to concern the specific matter that has been mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 指言论或文件涉及已经提到过的特定事项
senses.example: The clause refers only to overseas income.
senses.exampleCN: 该条款只涉及海外收入。
senses.why: A text is a collection of pointing words: when all the fingers land in one place, the text is about that place.
senses.whyCN: 文本是一堆指认的词：当所有的手指都落在同一处，这份文本就是关于那个地方的。

senses.title: Send a question for decision
senses.definition: to officially send a question, complaint, or plan to an authority that will decide it
senses.definitionCN: 把问题、投诉或方案正式送交有裁决权的机构处理
senses.example: Parliament referred the bill to a joint committee.
senses.exampleCN: 议会把该法案送交联合委员会审议。
senses.why: In formal use the carrying back becomes carrying up: the matter leaves ordinary hands and is deposited where decisions are made.
senses.whyCN: 在正式用法里，「带回」变成「上呈」：事项离开普通经手人，被交放到有权决断的地方。

intro.en: Refer comes from Latin referre 'to carry back, bring back, report', from re- 'back' + ferre 'to carry, bear'. Latin referre already meant both 'point to' and 'attribute to', and English has kept the double meaning since the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: refer 来自拉丁语 referre「带回、送回、报告」，由 re-「回」加 ferre「携带」构成。拉丁语 referre 本就兼有「指向」与「归因」两义，英语自十五世纪起一直保留这个双义。

items.en: The root bher- 'to carry' underlies Latin ferre, English bear, and Sanskrit bhárati. The idea of carrying something from one place to another is the shared core.
items.cn: 词根 bher-「携带」是拉丁语 ferre、英语 bear 和梵语 bhárati 的共同来源。「把某物从一处带到另一处」是三个词共享的核心。

items.en: Referre combined re- 'back, again' with ferre 'carry': to carry something back to its source, and hence to report it, relate it, or ascribe it to something.
items.cn: referre 由 re-「回、再」加 ferre「携带」构成：把某物带回源头，由此引申出「报告、叙述、归于某物」等义。

items.en: Referen is first recorded around 1382 with the religious sense 'to attribute glory to God' — carrying something back to its giver. The general sense 'to relate to, concern' appears in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: referen 最早记录于约 1382 年，为宗教义「把荣耀归于上帝」——把某物带回其授予者。泛义「与…有关、涉及」出现于十五世纪。

items.en: The senses 'consult a source' (c. 1600), 'send a person or case onward' (17th c.), and 'point to what a word stands for' (19th c.) all grow from the same image of carrying or pointing back.
items.cn: 「查阅资料」（约 1600 年）、「转送人或案件」（17 世纪）、「指词语所指」（19 世纪）各义都从「带回或指向」这同一意象生长出来。

items.en: The spelling rule is regular: refer doubles the final r in referred, referring, referral, because the stress falls on the last syllable. Reference and referee keep the single r of the noun family.
items.cn: 拼写规则很规整：refer 在重音落在末音节时构成 referred、referring、referral 时双写 r。名词一族的 reference、referee 则保持单 r。

note.en: The first group gathers words built on the same Latin ferre with re-: they all picture something carried back or between people. The second group compares the verbs of pointing to or mentioning something.
note.cn: 第一组汇集以同一拉丁词 ferre 加 re- 构成的词：它们都画着「某物被带回或转递」的图景。第二组比较几个「指向或提及」的动词。

entries.definition: the act of mentioning, or the source consulted. It is the noun built on refer.
entries.definitionCN: 提及的行为，或查阅的出处。它是由 refer 构成的名词。

entries.definition: originally the person to whom a disputed matter is referred, now the judge of a game. It names the handler, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 原指争议事项被提交给的人，现为比赛裁判。它命名处理者，而非动作。

entries.definition: the act of sending a patient or case to someone else. It doubles the r like the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 把病人或案件转交他人的行为。与动词一样双写 r。

entries.definition: to carry one thing before another, hence to like better. Different prefix, same ferre.
entries.definitionCN: 把一物置于另一物之前，引申为更喜欢。前缀不同，词根同为 ferre。

entries.definition: to carry across from one place or person to another. The carrying is across, not back.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物从一处或一人转到另一处或另一人。携带方向是「横过」而非「回」。

entries.definition: to speak of something briefly, without directing anyone to it. Mention names the act only; refer often adds the pointing.
entries.definitionCN: 简短谈到某事，但不指引任何人前往。mention 只命名这个动作；refer 常带指向。

entries.definition: to go to a book or expert for information. Consult stresses the seeking; refer to stresses the source you turn to.
entries.definitionCN: 向书或专家求取信息。consult 强调求取行为；refer to 强调你转向的那个出处。

entries.definition: to mention indirectly, touching on something without naming it. It is the indirect cousin of refer to.
entries.definitionCN: 间接提及，点到而不明说。它是 refer to 的间接式表亲。

entries.definition: to quote or name a source as authority. Cite fixes the exact source; refer only points the way.
entries.definitionCN: 引用或注明来源作为依据。cite 锁定确切出处；refer 只是指路。

normalIntro.en: Real parts and real relatives: Latin re- 'back' + ferre 'carry', the derived nouns reference, referral and referee, and the spelling rule of doubling the r.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分与真实同族词：拉丁语 re-「回」加 ferre「携带」，派生名词 reference、referral、referee，以及双写 r 的拼写规则。

normal.en: re- means back and ferre means carry: to refer is to carry the listener back to something.
normal.cn: re- 是「回」，ferre 是「携带」：refer 就是把听者带回某处。

normal.en: ferre is the same root as English bear: both picture something being carried.
normal.cn: ferre 与英语 bear 同根：两者都画着「某物被携带」的图景。

normal.en: The verb doubles its r when the stress is final: referred, referring, referral.
normal.cn: 重音在末音节时动词双写 r：referred、referring、referral。

normal.en: A referee is the one a dispute is referred to: the name keeps the whole grammar inside it.
normal.cn: referee 就是争议被 refer 给的那个人：这个词名把整个语法关系装在自身里。

normal.en: Doctors refer patients upward to specialists; readers refer downward to footnotes: the carrying back goes both ways.
normal.cn: 医生把病人向上转给专科医生；读者向下翻查脚注：「带回」是双向的。

abstract.en: Picture a hand stretched out pointing at a book on a far shelf: the gesture is the word.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸出去，指向远处书架上的一本书：这个手势就是这个词。

abstract.en: Every reference list is a row of fingers: each title points back to where an idea was born.
abstract.cn: 每份参考文献都是一排手指：每个书名都指回一个想法诞生的地方。

abstract.en: Refer is about direction, not detail: it tells you where to go, not what you will find.
abstract.cn: refer 的关键是指路，不是细节：它告诉你去哪，而不保证你会找到什么。

examples.en: The manager referred the complaint to the customer service team.
examples.cn: 经理把投诉转给了客服团队。

examples.en: Please refer to chapter five for the full data set.
examples.cn: 完整数据请查阅第五章。

examples.en: He often referred to his years abroad when explaining his habits.
examples.cn: 他解释自己的习惯时，常提起在国外的那些年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「锐赋」——锐赋老师答题时不直接给答案，只锐利地把你「赋」回课本那一页 → refer 指引查阅；提及（只借音，不表词源）

root: 源自拉丁语 referre「带回、送回」（re- 回 + ferre 携带），核心是「把人、话或事项带回到它本来的源头」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of refer, all from one gesture: something is carried or pointed back to a source — a person, a book, a cause, or the thing a word stands for.
sensesIntro.cn: refer 的九个义项都来自同一个手势：某物被带回或指向一个源头——一个人、一本书、一个原因，或一个词所指的事物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger stretched back toward the source of a thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指伸回去，指向某物的源头。

branches.en: SPEAKING: to mention something and to give it a name are both pointings made with words.
branches.cn: 言谈：提及某事和给某事起名称，都是用词语完成的指认。

branches.en: INFORMATION: either you are sent to the source, or you go to it yourself while working.
branches.cn: 信息：要么你被派往出处，要么你工作时自己走向出处。

branches.en: HANDING OVER: patients, cases, and bills are carried back and deposited with the proper handler.
branches.cn: 移交：病人、案件与法案被带回去，交放到合适的处理者手里。

branches.en: CAUSATION: a fact is carried back until it rests on the cause that produced it.
branches.cn: 因果：一个事实被带回，直到它落在产生它的原因上。

branches.en: MEANING: words and texts refer as fingers do — what they point at is what they are about.
branches.cn: 语义：词语与文本像手指一样指认——指向什么，就是关于什么。

intro.en: Refer shows the Latin prefix re- 'back' on the verb stem ferre 'carry'. English keeps the whole ferre family: prefer, transfer, confer, offer and suffer all carry the same verb with different prefixes.
intro.cn: refer 在动词词干 ferre「携带」上显示拉丁前缀 re-「回」。英语保留了整个 ferre 词族：prefer、transfer、confer、offer、suffer 都是同一动词配不同前缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is referre 'carry back' (re- 'back' + ferre 'carry, bear'). Ferre is one of the most productive Latin verbs: with each new prefix it builds a new English verb family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语源头是 referre「带回」（re-「回」+ ferre「携带、承载」）。ferre 是产出最高的拉丁动词之一：每换一个前缀，就生成一个新的英语动词家族。

items.meaning: to carry back to a source; to point to
items.meaningCN: 带回源头；指认（re- 回 + ferre 携带）
items.example: The article refers to several early studies.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章提到了几项早期研究。

items.meaning: an act of referring, or a source consulted
items.meaningCN: 提及；出处（-ence 构成行为名词）
items.example: Keep a list of every reference you use.
items.exampleCN: 把你用过的每条出处都列成清单。

items.meaning: the sending of a person or case onward
items.meaningCN: 转介；转诊（-al 构成行为名词）
items.example: The clinic made an urgent referral to the hospital.
items.exampleCN: 诊所向医院发出了紧急转诊。

items.meaning: the person a matter is referred to; a judge of a game
items.meaningCN: 裁判；受托处理者（-ee 表示被交给的人）
items.example: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.

items.meaning: to carry one option before another; to like better
items.meaningCN: 更喜欢；偏好（prae- 在前 + ferre 携带）
items.example: I prefer tea to coffee in the evening.
items.exampleCN: 晚上我更喜欢喝茶而不是咖啡。

items.meaning: to carry across to another place or owner
items.meaningCN: 转移；转让（trans- 横过 + ferre 携带）
items.example: He transferred to the Shanghai office last spring.
items.exampleCN: 他去年春天调到了上海办公室。

items.meaning: to bring views together in discussion; to bestow
items.meaningCN: 商议；授予（con- 一起 + ferre 携带）
items.example: The board conferred for two hours before voting.
items.exampleCN: 董事会商议了两个小时才投票。

items.meaning: to carry something toward someone; to present
items.meaningCN: 提供；主动提出（ob- 朝向 + ferre 携带）
items.example: She offered her seat to an elderly passenger.
items.exampleCN: 她把座位让给了一位年长乘客。

items.meaning: to carry something from under; to undergo hardship
items.meaningCN: 遭受；忍受（sub- 在下 + ferre 携带，即「在下面承受」）
items.example: The crops suffered from the long drought.
items.exampleCN: 庄稼因长期干旱而受损。

items.meaning: to carry a conclusion into the mind from evidence
items.meaningCN: 推断（in- 进入 + ferre 携带，即「把结论带进心中」）
items.example: From the wet floor we inferred that it had rained.
items.exampleCN: 从湿漉漉的地面我们推断下过雨。

latinEntries.meaning: to carry back; to report; to ascribe

definition_zh: 观察；观测；观察结果；评论；（对规则的）遵守
definition_en: the act of watching something carefully, a recorded result of such watching, or a remark based on it
core_image: 一个人站在窗前，手里拿着本子，把鸟落下的时间一秒一秒写下来。
scene: 医生让病人先留院一晚，第二天早上再看检查数据。 The patient stayed in the hospital for a night of observation.
sceneCN: 这里 observation 是“医学上的观察期、留观”（第 4 个义项）；句意：病人留院接受一晚的观察；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 观察；观测；观察结果；评论；遵守

senses.title: Watching with attention
senses.definition: the act of watching someone or something closely and with attention
senses.definitionCN: 密切而专注地注视某人或某事的行为
senses.example: Careful observation showed that the birds returned at the same hour each day.
senses.exampleCN: 仔细观察显示，这些鸟每天在同一时刻返回。
senses.why: Observation is not passive seeing: the watcher has chosen an object and a purpose, so attention is the defining element.
senses.whyCN: 观察不是被动地看见：观察者已经选定了对象与目的，因此“专注”才是定义性的要素。

senses.title: A recorded result
senses.titleCN: 观察结果：本子上那行字
senses.definition: a piece of information obtained by watching and often written down for later use
senses.definitionCN: 通过观察获得、常被记录下来备用的信息
senses.example: The notebook contained observations from six mornings at the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 笔记本里记着六个早晨在湖边的观察结果。
senses.why: Once written, the act becomes a fact others can read; the word then names the record rather than the watching.
senses.whyCN: 一旦写下来，行为就变成别人可读的事实；此时这个词命名的是记录，而不是“看”本身。

senses.title: A remark drawn from noticing
senses.definition: a spoken or written remark based on something noticed
senses.definitionCN: 基于所注意到的事情而作出的口头或书面评论
senses.example: His observation that the room felt colder was correct.
senses.exampleCN: 他说房间变冷了，这个观察是对的。
senses.why: The sense shifts from the eye to the mouth: a remark is called an observation when it reports a noticed fact rather than an opinion.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项从眼睛移到嘴：当一句话报告的是被注意到的事实而非意见时，它就被称作 observation。

senses.title: A medical watch
senses.titleCN: 留观：先看着，等数据说话
senses.definition: a period during which a patient is watched in hospital before a decision is made
senses.definitionCN: 病人留院接受看护、等待作出决定的一段时间
senses.example: She was kept in observation overnight after the fall.
senses.exampleCN: 摔倒后她被留院观察了一夜。
senses.why: Medicine uses observation as a treatment stage: when the diagnosis is still open, watching is safer than acting.
senses.whyCN: 医学把观察当作一个治疗阶段：诊断尚未确定时，看着比动手更安全。

senses.title: Keeping a rule
senses.titleCN: 遵守：把规定看在眼里并照做
senses.definition: the keeping or honouring of a law, custom, or religious practice
senses.definitionCN: 遵守或尊重法律、习俗或宗教实践
senses.example: Observation of the Sabbath was strict in that community.
senses.exampleCN: 那个社群对安息日的遵守很严格。
senses.why: The older sense of observare is to heed or keep; the same verb that means watch over also means keep faith with a rule.
senses.whyCN: observare 更早的含义是“留意、守护”；同一个既表示“看护”又表示“守信于规则”的动词。

senses.title: A post for watching
senses.titleCN: 观察位：专门用来盯的地方
senses.definition: a place, especially a military one, set up for watching an area
senses.definitionCN: 为监视某一区域而设置的场所，尤指军事用途
senses.example: The soldiers held the observation post on the ridge through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们整夜守住山脊上的观察哨。
senses.why: The act needs a place; when watching is continuous, the place itself takes the name and becomes part of the operation.
senses.whyCN: 观察需要地点；当观察持续进行时，地点本身也取了这个名字，成为行动的一部分。

senses.title: Studying from inside a group
senses.titleCN: 参与式观察：进去，同时记下来
senses.definition: a research method in which the researcher joins a group and records its life while taking part in it
senses.definitionCN: 研究者加入某群体、在参与其生活的同时作记录的研究方法
senses.example: Her participant observation of the night market lasted a full year.
senses.exampleCN: 她对夜市的参与式观察持续了整整一年。
senses.why: The method accepts a tension: to see ordinary life closely one must enter it, yet entering changes what is being observed.
senses.whyCN: 这种方法接受一种张力：要贴近看日常生活就必须进去，可一旦进去，被观察的对象也变了。

senses.title: Measuring the sky
senses.titleCN: 天文观测：把望远镜对准天上
senses.definition: the systematic recording of celestial objects and events with instruments
senses.definitionCN: 用仪器对天体与天象作系统记录
senses.example: The observation of the eclipse required clear skies and an exact location.
senses.exampleCN: 观测这次日食需要晴朗天空和精确地点。
senses.why: Astronomy turns observation into data: the eye is replaced by a detector, and the record must state time, place, and instrument.
senses.whyCN: 天文学把观察变成数据：眼睛被探测器取代，记录必须写明时间、地点与仪器。

intro.en: Observation comes from Latin observatio, a watching or a heed, from observare: ob- 'over, before' plus servare 'to keep, watch over'. Servare also gives preserve, reserve, and conserve.
intro.cn: observation 来自拉丁语 observatio“看护、留意”，出自 observare：ob-“在上、在前”加 servare“守护、留意”。servare 还给出 preserve、reserve、conserve。

items.en: Servare meant to keep, guard, or preserve. The idea of keeping is older than the idea of looking.
items.cn: servare 意为保持、守护、保存。“守”的观念比“看”的观念更早。

items.en: Ob- added the sense of direction or attention: to watch over, to heed, to keep a rule, and to observe signs.
items.cn: ob- 增加了方向与注意的含义：看护、留意、遵守规则，以及观察征兆。

items.en: The noun covered watching, noting, and also compliance with a custom or a law.
items.cn: 该名词涵盖看护、记录，也涵盖对习俗或法律的遵守。

items.en: French kept both the watching sense and the remark sense, and English borrowed both in the 14th century.
items.cn: 法语同时保留了“观察”与“评论”两义，英语于 14 世纪把两者一并借入。

items.en: English observation grew in science and navigation, where watching had to be recorded with time and place.
items.cn: 英语 observation 在科学与航海领域壮大，那里的观察必须连同时间与地点一起记录。

items.en: The 19th and 20th centuries added medical observation, participant observation, and instrument-based astronomical observation.
items.cn: 19 与 20 世纪增加了医学留观、参与式观察，以及依靠仪器的天文观测。

note.en: The first group is the observe family; the second compares ways of gaining knowledge by watching, checking, or testing.
note.cn: 第一组是 observe 词族；第二组比较通过观看、核查或检验获取知识的几种方式。

entries.definition: to watch carefully, to notice, or to keep a rule. It names the action behind observation.
entries.definitionCN: 仔细观察、注意到，或遵守规则；命名的是 observation 背后的动作。

entries.definition: a person who watches, especially one sent to report on an event.
entries.definitionCN: 观察的人，尤指被派去报道某一事件的人。

entries.definition: quick to notice things; also careful to keep a rule.
entries.definitionCN: 善于注意细节的；也指谨慎守规的。

entries.definition: the keeping of a law, rite, or custom. It is the 'compliance' sense without the scientific one.
entries.definitionCN: 对法律、仪式或习俗的遵守；只有“遵从”义，没有科学观察义。

entries.definition: looking at something over time, often without a formal purpose. Observation adds method.
entries.definitionCN: 持续地看，常无正式目的；observation 则增加了方法。

entries.definition: continuous checking by instruments or staff, usually against limits. It is observation with a threshold.
entries.definitionCN: 用仪器或人员持续核查，通常对照限值；是有阈值的观察。

entries.definition: the assignment of a number to a property. It turns observation into quantity.
entries.definitionCN: 给性质赋予数值；它把观察变成数量。

entries.definition: something said briefly. It need not be based on careful watching.
entries.definitionCN: 简短说出的话；不必基于仔细的观察。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: ob- 'over' plus servare 'keep'. Observation is keeping watch, and keeping a rule.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：ob-“在上”加 servare“守护”。observation 就是守望着，也是守着规则。

normal.en: Observe means both to watch and to keep: the same act of holding something in view.
normal.cn: observe 既表示“看”，也表示“守”：都是把某物保持在视野里。

normal.en: An observation notebook is a watch that leaves a mark.
normal.cn: 观察笔记本就是一只会留下痕迹的表。

normal.en: In hospital, observation is a room where time does the testing.
normal.cn: 在医院，observation 是一间让时间来检验的病房。

normal.en: An observation post is the act of watching with a fixed address.
normal.cn: 观察哨就是有了固定地址的“看”。

normal.en: Astronomers write down three things: what, when, and with which instrument.
normal.cn: 天文学家记三件事：看到了什么、什么时候、用什么仪器。

abstract.en: Observation never arrives pure; the choice of what to watch is already a theory about what matters.
abstract.cn: 观察从不以纯粹状态到来；选择看什么，本身已是关于“什么重要”的理论。

abstract.en: The same verb means to watch and to obey, as if attention and loyalty came from one root.
abstract.cn: 同一个动词既表示观看又表示服从，仿佛注意与忠诚出自同一根。

abstract.en: To observe a group closely is to change it; the observer is always part of the observed world.
abstract.cn: 近距离观察一个群体就会改变它；观察者永远是被观察世界的一部分。

examples.en: The ornithologist's observation of the nest lasted from dawn until the chicks fledged.
examples.cn: 这位鸟类学家对鸟巢的观察从黎明持续到雏鸟长出飞羽。

examples.en: After the head injury, the patient stayed under observation for twenty-four hours.
examples.cn: 头部受伤后，病人留院观察了二十四小时。

examples.en: Her observation that the machine ran quieter after warming up turned out to be important.
examples.cn: 她观察到机器预热后运转更安静，后来证明这一点很重要。

dict_mnemonic.text: observe（观察）+ ation（名词）——看得很仔细，还记下来，就是观察、观测。

root: 源自拉丁语 observatio（看护、留意、遵从），出自 observare：ob-“在上、在前”加 servare“守护、保持”。同一词根兼有“看”与“守”两面，因此既指观察、观测，也指对规则、习俗的遵守。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of observation, all descended from one act of keeping watch. The watch can be scientific, medical, military, or social; its product can be a record, a remark, a data set, or a habit of obeying.
sensesIntro.cn: observation 的八个义项都源自同一个“守望”动作。守望可以是科学的、医学的、军事的或社会的；其产物可以是记录、评论、数据集，或遵守的习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person at a window with a notebook, writing down the exact second a bird lands.
core.cn: 核心意象：窗边的人拿着本子，记下鸟落下的那一秒。

branches.en: THE ACT AND ITS RECORD: watching with purpose, and the line written down afterwards.
branches.cn: 行为与记录：有目的地看，以及随后写下的那一行。

branches.en: WORD AND RULE: a remark drawn from noticing, and the keeping of a law or custom.
branches.cn: 言语与规则：由注意得出的评论，以及对法律或习俗的遵守。

branches.en: MEDICAL WAITING: a patient watched until the evidence becomes clear.
branches.cn: 医学等待：病人被观察到证据明朗为止。

branches.en: PLACE AND METHOD: a post built for watching, and a researcher watching from inside a group.
branches.cn: 地点与方法：为观察而建的哨位，以及研究者从群体内部观察。

branches.en: INSTRUMENTAL WATCHING: the sky recorded with time, place, and detector.
branches.cn: 仪器化观察：连同时间、地点与探测器一起记录天空。

intro.en: Observation is observe plus -ation, the action-noun suffix. The family adds -er for the person, -ant for the habit, -ance for the keeping of a rule, and -able for what can be seen.
intro.cn: observation 是 observe 加 -ation（动作名词后缀）。词族用 -er 表示人，-ant 表示习性，-ance 表示对规则的遵守，-able 表示可被看见。

latinIntro.en: The base is servare, to keep or guard, with ob- adding the direction of attention. Related Latin words give preserve, reserve, conserve, and servant.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是 servare“保持、守护”，ob- 增加注意的方向。相关拉丁词给出 preserve、reserve、conserve、servant。

items.meaning: to watch closely, notice, or keep a rule
items.example: Scientists observe the same plot every spring.
items.exampleCN: 科学家每年春天观察同一块样地。

items.meaning: the act, result, or remark of watching
items.meaningCN: 观察的行为、结果或评论
items.example: His observation was recorded in the margin.
An observer sat at the back of the meeting.
items.exampleCN: 一名观察员坐在会议后排。

items.meaning: quick to notice; careful to comply
items.meaningCN: 善于察觉的；谨慎遵守的
items.example: An observant reader will spot the repeated date.
items.exampleCN: 细心的读者会注意到重复出现的日期。

items.meaning: the keeping of a law, rite, or custom
items.meaningCN: 对法律、仪式或习俗的遵守
items.example: Observance of the treaty was monitored by neutrals.
items.exampleCN: 条约的遵守情况由中立国监督。

items.meaning: able to be seen or noticed
items.example: The effect is observable only at low temperatures.
items.exampleCN: 这一效应只在低温下可观察到。

items.meaning: a place built for watching the sky or nature
items.meaningCN: 为观测天空或自然而建的场所；天文台
items.example: The observatory opens to the public on Fridays.
items.exampleCN: 这座天文台周五向公众开放。

items.meaning: to keep something safe from harm or change
items.meaningCN: 保护某物免受损害或改变；保存
items.example: The salt preserves the fish for the winter.

items.meaning: to keep back for later use
items.example: They reserved two seats near the window.
items.exampleCN: 他们预留了两个靠窗座位。

items.meaning: to keep from being lost or wasted
items.example: The town conserves water during dry summers.
items.exampleCN: 这个镇在干旱夏季节约用水。

latinEntries.meaning: to watch over, heed, comply with
a watching, a remark, a compliance

definition_zh: 规模；刻度；鳞
definition_en: the size or extent of something, a set of marks for measuring, or a thin plate on a fish
core_image: 地图角落的一小段比例尺，标注着图上距离与现实距离的关系
scene: 地图下方标着比例尺。 A scale is printed at the bottom of the map.
sceneCN: 这里 scale 是「刻度；比例尺」（第 2 个义项）；句意：地图底部印着比例尺。

senses.title: Size and extent
senses.definition: the size or extent of something, especially when large
senses.definitionCN: 某事物的规模或范围，尤指较大规模
senses.example: The project was built on a huge scale.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目以巨大的规模建成。
senses.why: The core abstract sense is how far something reaches.
senses.whyCN: 核心抽象义是事物所达到的范围。

senses.title: Measuring marks
senses.definition: a set of marks or numbers used for measuring
senses.definitionCN: 用于测量的一组刻度或数字
senses.example: Read the weight on the scale.
senses.exampleCN: 读出秤上的重量。
senses.why: A ladder of marks turns size into a readable measure.
senses.whyCN: 一串刻度把大小转化为可读的度量。

senses.title: Fish plate
senses.definition: one of the thin hard plates covering a fish or reptile
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖鱼或爬行动物身体的薄硬片
senses.example: The fish's scales shone in the light.
senses.exampleCN: 鱼鳞在光下闪闪发亮。
senses.why: The layered plates look like small measuring marks.
senses.whyCN: 层叠的薄片看起来像小刻度。

senses.title: Weighing device
senses.definition: a device with two pans for weighing, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 通常用复数形式，指带两个秤盘的天平
senses.example: Place the fruit on the scales.
senses.exampleCN: 把水果放在秤上。
senses.why: The balanced beam is marked like a measuring scale.
senses.whyCN: 平衡的横梁像测量刻度一样被标记。

senses.title: Climb up
senses.definition: to climb up or over something steep
senses.definitionCN: 攀上或翻越陡峭之物
senses.example: They scaled the wall before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在黎明前翻过了墙。
senses.why: Climbing a ladder resembles moving up a scale.
senses.whyCN: 爬梯子就像沿着刻度向上移动。

senses.title: Resize proportionally
senses.definition: to change the size of something while keeping its proportions
senses.definitionCN: 在保持比例的情况下改变某物的大小
senses.example: Scale the image to fit the page.
senses.exampleCN: 把图片缩放到适合页面。
senses.why: A scale keeps every part in the same ratio.
senses.whyCN: 比例尺让每个部分保持相同比率。

intro.en: Scale comes from Latin scala, a ladder or flight of steps.
intro.cn: scale 源自拉丁语 scala，意为梯子或一段台阶。

items.en: Scala means a ladder or a flight of steps.
items.cn: scala 意为梯子或一段台阶。

items.en: Scalae, the plural, named steps used for climbing.
items.cn: 复数 scalae 指用于攀爬的台阶。

items.en: Escale carried the sense of a ladder and a measure.
items.cn: escale 兼有梯子和度量之义。

items.en: Scale named a graduated measure and a climbing act.
items.cn: scale 指分级刻度和攀登动作。

items.en: The musical scale borrowed the ladder image.
items.cn: 音乐音阶借用了梯子的意象。

items.en: Scale extends to maps, models, and business size.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scale 扩展到地图、模型和商业规模。

note.en: Scale is compared with similar spellings and with words for size and measurement.
note.cn: 把 scale 与形近词以及表示大小和度量的词作比较。

the skin on the top of the head
a shellfish with a fan-shaped shell

normalIntro.en: Scale can be remembered as a ladder of marks that measures many things.
normalIntro.cn: 可以把 scale 记成一串刻度阶梯，用来度量许多事物。

normal.en: A scale is a ladder of marks, from Latin scala.
normal.cn: scale 是一串刻度阶梯，源自拉丁语 scala。

normal.en: Fish scales overlap like the steps of a tiny ladder.
normal.cn: 鱼鳞层叠，就像微型梯子的台阶。

normal.en: Scale up means enlarge, scale down means reduce.
normal.cn: scale up 是扩大，scale down 是缩小。

normal.en: On a large scale means at a great size.
normal.cn: on a large scale 意为以巨大规模。

normal.en: The scales in a bathroom measure your weight.
normal.cn: 浴室的秤用来测量体重。

abstract.en: Every scale is a promise that size can be compared.
abstract.cn: 每一种刻度都意味着大小可以被比较。

abstract.en: A model keeps the scale but loses the weight.
abstract.cn: 模型保留比例，却失去了重量。

abstract.en: Climbing and measuring share the image of steps.
abstract.cn: 攀登与测量共享台阶的意象。

examples.en: The company expanded on an international scale.
examples.cn: 这家公司以国际规模扩张。

examples.en: The map has a scale of one to fifty thousand.
examples.cn: 这张地图的比例尺是一比五万。

examples.en: Workers scaled the cliff to reach the cave.
examples.cn: 工人们攀上悬崖到达洞穴。

dict_mnemonic.text: scale 源自「梯子」，梯子的台阶就是刻度；由此引申出规模、比例尺、音阶、鱼鳞和攀登。

root: 源自拉丁语 scala（梯子、台阶），核心义「一级一级的量度」，由此扩展到规模、刻度、比例与攀登。

sensesIntro.en: Scale means size, measuring marks, fish plates, a weighing device, climbing, or resizing.
sensesIntro.cn: scale 意为规模、刻度、鱼鳞、天平、攀登，或按比例缩放。

core.en: A ladder-like set of steps used to measure or climb.
core.cn: 像梯子一样用于度量或攀爬的一级级台阶。

branches.en: Measured size becomes the idea of scale.
branches.cn: 被度量的大小成为规模概念。

branches.en: The marks themselves form a measuring scale.
branches.cn: 刻度本身构成测量标尺。

branches.en: Overlapping plates resemble tiny steps.
branches.cn: 层叠的鳞片像微小的台阶。

branches.en: The weighing beam is marked like a scale.
branches.cn: 天平横梁像刻度尺一样被标记。

branches.en: Climbing up and scaling an image both follow a ratio.
branches.cn: 向上攀登与缩放图像都遵循某种比率。

intro.en: Scale has a productive family in measurement and technology.
intro.cn: scale 在度量与技术领域有能产的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin scala, a ladder, is the source of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scala（梯子）是整个词族的来源。

items.meaning: a weighing device or fish plates
the act of climbing or resizing

items.meaning: able to grow or be resized

items.example: They tested the scalability of the app.
